_comment: HYPOTHETICAL operational assumptions for the fictional orthopaedic clinic. Station capacity, service times, opening times, other-department demand and thresholds are read from data/original/ortho_stations.csv; the values below come from tools/generate_ortho_data.py (the simulator that produced the datasets). Used by the replay as background conditions (team approval 2026-11-10) and by the router for expected service and travel times. Not real hospital policy.
consult_queue: expedited first, then max(appointment time, join time - 30 min); REVIEW uses join time - 10 min

routing._tuned_on: Aug-Sep 2025 replay (validation); margin 5 min had the best clinic-wide mean and fewest route changes
